safety_boundary: These interfaces are lab inhibit/permit mechanisms, not certified functional safety. Selecting an option below does not create an STO claim.

J501.current_topology: Two-wire remote contact between INTERLOCK_FEED and INTERLOCK_RAW.
J501.short_failure_semantics: A short across J501 pins 1-2 is electrically indistinguishable from a closed/healthy remote contact.

EOL_SUPERVISED_INPUT.description: Place a reviewed end-of-line resistance/network at the remote contact and measure a window rather than only binary closure.
required_design_changes: window comparator or ADC measurement path

DUAL_CHANNEL_MONITORED.description: Use two independently routed/monitored channels with discrepancy diagnostics.

ACCEPT_NON_SAFETY_RESIDUAL_RISK.description: Retain the two-wire contact as a non-safety service interlock and explicitly accept that pair-short can look healthy.
required_evidence: requirements signoff that cable-short fail-safe behavior is not claimed

J501.close_rule: selected_resolution and its design/evidence contract must be reviewed before the cable-short semantic blocker can leave pre-layout review

J701.current_topology: Single floating two-wire PhotoMOS contact presented as DUT_PERMIT_A/B.
J701.short_failure_semantics: A short across DUT_PERMIT_A/B can bypass the HIL open-contact inhibit; whether the DUT detects that short is entirely DUT-interface dependent.

DUT_SIDE_LINE_MONITORING.description: Bind a real DUT input that independently diagnoses line short/open or uses a coded/test-pulse permit input.

DUAL_MONITORED_PERMIT.description: Redesign to two independent permit channels consumed by a DUT that performs discrepancy/line diagnostics.

ACCEPT_NON_SAFETY_RESIDUAL_RISK.description: Retain one floating permit as a non-safety lab inhibit and explicitly state that pair-short can force permit.

J701.close_rule: selected_resolution must be consistent with the real DUT adapter and measured cable-fault behavior before the cable-short semantic blocker can leave pre-layout review
